meta.name: caveman-help
meta.description: Quick-reference card for caveman modes, skills and commands. Trigger: /caveman-help or "caveman help".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 随手调出速查卡,弄清有哪些模式和指令可用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常记不清有哪些模式和命令可以调用
copy.tagline_en: Pull up a cheat sheet to see which modes and commands are available
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep forgetting which modes and commands exist

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-help 或说 “caveman help” 后，Claude 会输出一张 caveman 速查卡片，列出 6 种压缩模式和相关技能、命令。它只输出一次：不改模式、不写标记文件、不保存任何内容，卡片本身用 caveman 风格写。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-help 或说出 “caveman help” 时触发并显示这张卡片。它是一次性的，不会持续改变会话状态。

say.note: 显示模式与技能速查卡片
退出 caveman 模式，恢复正常回复

howto.what_en: Typing /caveman-help or saying "caveman help" makes Claude print a caveman reference card listing 6 modes, plus related skills and commands. One-shot: no mode change, no flag files, nothing persisted. Written in caveman style.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /caveman-help or say "caveman help". It fires once and does not persist any state.

say_en.note: Show the modes and skills reference card
Exit caveman mode, back to normal replies
